siteMeta.title: A Storybook for Kritika 📖✨
siteMeta.subtitle: A little bundle of love for the birthday girl

guesses.text: You are currently bundled up in your coziest blanket, sipping something warm.
Your hands or sketchbook have some stray paint streaks from a sudden burst of creativity.
You have mentally scheduled at least three different cake tastings this week.
A song came on recently and you couldn't help doing a private dance routine in your room.
You were wondering if everyone forgot your belated celebration... (Never in a million years!).

chapters.heading: Mom & Daddy
chapters.intro: Endless love, warmest blessings, and the pillars of your life.

entries.caption: My darling Lucky
entries.message: To my sweetest Kritika, watching you bring so much warmth, kindness, and art into our home is my greatest happiness. May God bless you with the strongest health, vibrant smiles, and peaceful days ahead. Eat well and rest up, my baby!

entries.caption: Daddy's pride and joy
entries.message: My dearest Lucky, you will always be my little girl who danced around the living room and filled the house with joy. Keep dreaming high and painting your life in radiant colors. I am always in your corner. Happy belated birthday beta!

chapters.heading: The OG Opp 💥
chapters.intro: Your sister: lifelong roommate, clothes thief, and undisputed rival.
wantedCrimes: Unauthorized borrowing of hoodies and scrunchies
Eating 75% of the birthday cake frosting without shame
Hosting unprovoked midnight dance concerts in our shared space
Painting masterworks while leaving brushes unwashed for days
chapters.confession: Okay fine, I admit it! You might be annoying sometimes, but life would be so dreadfully boring without my favorite opponent. You're the best sister anyone could ask for. Happy birthday Lucky, stay weird! 💖

chapters.heading: Cousin Air Mail ✈️
chapters.intro: Tap on any cousin's snapshot to unfold their personal Air Mail letter!

entries.name: Aarav
entries.caption: Summer Goa Trip
entries.letter: Hey Lucky! Family reunions without you are just people sitting around awkwardly. Missing your chaos and dance energy. Get well soon, we have vacation plans to make! Happy belated birthday!

entries.name: Simran
entries.caption: Sangeet Practice
entries.letter: Happy Belated Birthday to my favorite dance buddy! Still waiting for you to teach me that routine. Wishing you radiant health and endless laughter this year. Love you tons!

entries.name: Kabir
entries.caption: Midnight Pizza Run
entries.letter: Lucky! Heard you missed the big birthday dinner because you were under the weather. That just means we owe you a double celebration. The next cake is on me! Get healthy fast.

entries.name: Diya
entries.caption: Pottery Workshop
entries.letter: To the most creative soul in the family: sending you the biggest hugs across the miles! Never stop painting and shining your light. Happy belated birthday, Lucky beta!

chapters.heading: The Friends Corkboard
chapters.intro: Tap any photo to zoom in and read their note! (And don't miss the Memory Jar 🫙)

entries.caption: Late night giggles
entries.message: Happy belated birthday Lucky! Missing our endless tea sessions and spontaneous dance breaks. Get fully rested and back on your feet soon—we have so many adventures lined up!

entries.caption: Watercolor chaos
entries.message: To the undisputed queen of creativity and dance floor energy: so glad to know you! Wishing you the happiest, healthiest year ahead. Don't stop painting!

entries.caption: Sweet tooth crew
entries.message: Nobody appreciates a delicious slice of chocolate cake quite like you do. We saved the biggest slice for our reunion celebration! Get well soon and shine on!

entries.caption: Café hopping days
entries.message: Lucky, life is so much brighter with your laughs! Take all the time you need to recover, drink all the warm tea, and let everyone spoil you. Happy belated birthday!

entries.caption: Concert night
entries.message: Happy birthday Lucky! Next time we hang out, I promise to let you pick the playlist for the first 30 minutes. Rest up and bounce back with your signature energy!

entries.caption: Library escape
entries.message: To my rock and sweetest confidante: I hope this year brings you peace, vibrant health, and endless inspiration. You deserve the sweetest things in the universe!

entries.caption: College festival
entries.message: The dance floor is literally not the same without Lucky! Sending you huge hugs and prayers for a speedy recovery. Can't wait to celebrate properly!

entries.caption: Sunset memories
entries.message: Happy belated birthday Lucky! May your camera roll always be full of aesthetic shots and happy days. Wishing you the happiest year yet!

memoryJarNotes: Remember that time you tried teaching everyone that impossible dance choreo at midnight? Classic Lucky! 💃😂
The legendary 45-minute debate over whether chocolate truffle or red velvet reigns supreme! 🍰✨
That spontaneous watercolor afternoon where more paint ended up on your elbows than the sketchbook! 🎨💖
The emergency 2 AM chai run when everyone was exhausted but couldn't stop laughing! ☕🌙
When you convinced everyone that wearing cozy fuzzy socks outside was 'high fashion'! 🧦✨

closingLetter.title: A Note from Prem
closingLetter.message:
Hey Kritika,

We know being unwell on your birthday wasn't in the plan, but birthdays don't expire—and neither does how much everyone loves and cherishes you.

Take all the time you need to recover, drink all the warm tea, and let this little scrapbook remind you of all the smiles waiting for you on the other side.

Happy Belated Birthday, Lucky! 🎂✨
